prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean an indoor UV/tanning-bed salon or a spray (sunless) tan studio? I can give specific, highly rated salon names if you tell me which neighborhood or ZIP code in Columbus — otherwise here’s quick guidance and what to look for so you find the best option for you.

If you want a recommendation right away
- Tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood (e.g., Short North, Worthington, Westerville, New Albany, etc.) and whether you prefer spray or UV beds and I’ll give a short list of top-rated salons near you, with why they stand out.

How to pick the best salon
- Type: Decide UV beds vs. spray tan. Spray tans are much safer (no UV damage). UV beds increase skin cancer/aging risk.
- Reviews & reputation: Look for 4.5+ stars on Google/Yelp with many recent reviews.
- Cleanliness & equipment: Clean booths, up-to-date beds or a map of bed age/brand. For spray, private booths and fresh spray equipment.
- Staff training: Certified technicians for spray tans (airbrush or automated systems) or staff who explain bed times/lotion choices.
- Products: For spray, ask what solution they use (DHA concentration, bronzers, organic or sensitive-skin options). For UV, ask about lotions and bed strength.
- Patch test and consultation: Good studios offer a skin-sensitivity patch test and color consultation.
- Pricing & packages: Compare single sessions vs. membership packages; ask about expiration and transferability.
- Safety & aftercare: For spray tans they should give clear prep and aftercare instructions. For UV, they should counsel on safe exposure times.
- Red flags: Dirty facilities, pushy membership sales, no clear training, no reviews or many recent complaints.

Safety note
- If health is a priority, choose spray (sunless) tanning over UV tanning. If you still use UV beds, follow recommended exposure times, use eye protection, and consult a dermatologist if you have a history of skin cancer.

If you want, give me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you want spray or UV and I’ll list the top salons in Columbus with ratings and what each is best for.
